main_text.p: tricas & pericula:cunctantur, quando cōn filio,re,manu,vt adsit laborantibus suppliciter rogantur: negant quando consultum circa aliena & periculosa negocia,πολυπρα-γμονᾶν[?]: vt numerò, cum Iacobò Apostolo di cam,fratribus & sororibus nudis,quotidia no victu destitutis: verbis satisfaciunt, dicentes: Abite cum pacè, calescite & saturamini: nec dant eis quae sunt apta corpori. Iac. 2.15.16.

Vbi autem eosdem, armis Antichristia-norum, oppressos, partim etiam fortunis spoliatos & in exilium actos, quosdam etiā occisos pro Christi gloria, animaduerterunt: tum vero Edomiticum odium, praeiudicijs iniquisimis de religionis corruptelis: crudelitatem, persequutoribus neutiquā manum inijciendo: inhospitalitatem, exules & aduenas inhumanissimè repellendo: in pietatem, exercitia verè religionis aduenis denegādo: & pro Christi gloria interfectos ab Antichristianis Satanae martyres contumeliosè vocando: denique Dei seruos tam in Christi sinu, tam suauiter quiescentes, quàm superstites, rabiosè convicijs proscindendo, aliisque multis modis declarant.
QVAENAM AVTEM ILLORVM MERCES est à Iehouah Deo nostro?

page.notes: Running head and page number taken from the top of the page. The Greek word at the line end is read with doubt (πολυπρα-/γμονᾶν). "cōn" in "quando cōn filio" is uncertain. The line-initial "im" in "im pietatem" is probably a printing error for "in". The last word "tio." is the end of "Exterminatio", written whole. The line "QVAENAM AVTEM ..." is a bold small-capitals question. The line "Confusio primùm..." is set in bold type; it is treated as a paragraph here.
